visual_review.method: Agent inspected full final PNG and JPEG preview using view_image.
visual_review.new_mark: Two worn charcoal doorways joined by a thin ochre path on bare lower-right rock.
visual_review.pepe: Existing wide mouth and heavy-lidded eyes preserved exactly outside the addition.
visual_review.hands: Two existing hands, each visually counted as four fingers and a thumb; no new hands or handprints.
visual_review.writing: No new letters, numbers, captions, signatures, logos, watermarks, borders or frames observed.
visual_review.preservation: Zero decoded RGB pixels outside addition bounds changed; original dimensions, cracks, light and framing retained.
visual_review.palette: New pigment uses charcoal and yellow ochre; original pigments retained.

unmet_visual_requirements: Inherited cave rock retains a photographic appearance; changing it would violate the required preservation of rock and framing.
limitations: No independent visual approval. Small JPEG preview softens the thin ochre connector.
generator: Installed mcp image generate_image tool (flux-schnell), followed by pigment-only Node compositing.
prompt: Two irregular charcoal stone arches linked by a short yellow ochre path, prehistoric worn pigments, no text or hands; transfer onto existing bare cave rock.
